half moon run.bio: Montréal indie band Half Moon Run builds expansive folk-rock and art-pop around multi-instrumental arrangements, layered harmonies and a collaborative chemistry forged in the city's Mile End scene.

high klassified.bio: Montréal producer High Klassified makes atmospheric hip-hop and trap shaped by lush synths, detailed beat programming and collaborations across Québec's rap and R&B scenes.

hollerado.bio: Ottawa-area indie-rock band Hollerado pairs power-pop hooks with a DIY touring ethic and high-energy live shows, returning to activity after an initial 2019 farewell.

holly mcnarland.bio: Winnipeg-raised Métis singer-songwriter Holly McNarland became a major Canadian alternative-rock voice in the 1990s with emotionally intense writing and a distinctive whisper-to-a-scream vocal range.

ian kamau.bio: Toronto artist Ian Kamau works across hip-hop, spoken word, writing, design and visual art, using multidisciplinary storytelling to explore family, identity, memory and community.

in essence.bio: Toronto R&B group In Essence combined vocal harmonies with contemporary soul and won the 2004 Juno Award for R&B/Soul Recording of the Year for The Master Plan.

in essense.bio: Toronto R&B group In Essence combined vocal harmonies with contemporary soul and won the 2004 Juno Award for R&B/Soul Recording of the Year for The Master Plan.

infinite.bio: Toronto rapper Infinite, born Desmond Francis, emerged from Ghetto Concept and became known for technically sharp Canadian hip-hop as well as work on the Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike soundtrack.

jacksoul.bio: Toronto soul and R&B group jacksoul, fronted by the late Haydain Neale, built a multi-Juno-winning catalogue around warm vocals, sophisticated arrangements and polished songwriting.

jahkoy.bio: Toronto-born singer, rapper and songwriter JAHKOY moves between contemporary R&B, soul, trap and pop, building a versatile catalogue after beginning his career as a teenage rapper.

jamie fine.bio: Ottawa-born singer-songwriter Jamie Fine makes emotionally direct Canadian pop that grew from her platinum-selling duo work into a solo career built around candid, cathartic songwriting.

jann arden.bio: Alberta singer-songwriter Jann Arden is a multi-platinum Canadian pop artist, actor and author whose deeply personal catalogue has earned eight Juno Awards and Canadian Music Hall of Fame induction.

jarvis church.bio: Jamaican-Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Jarvis Church, born Gerald Eaton, is the lead vocalist of The Philosopher Kings and an accomplished solo R&B artist and producer.

jd era.bio: Mississauga-born rapper JD Era is a Canadian lyricist and freestyle specialist whose independent career includes Juno-nominated work and collaborations with major hip-hop artists.
